searchText: And that's scheduled for Nov? The PoW -> PoS upgrade is roughly scheduled for the first half of 2022 Here is the PR to the execution-apis repo that introduces Engine API. Interop edition, https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/74 What <@425572898787426305> means is that there is no release date set, and the transition will happen when it is ready. 😉 There is a reasonable chance that will happen in the first half of 2022, but it also could be later or earlier. Right, it would not be correct to say that it is *scheduled*
